record.rationale: Binds Calc Dedicated Worker messages to the filter runtime and returns terminal results or errors with transferable output buffers. This is local browser integration infrastructure; no native LibreOffice file ownership or semantic parity is claimed. Calc binds its Worker listener immediately and awaits the realm-local native libxml2 initialization inside every request, preserving early requests and ordinary initialization-error responses. Native pointers and UNO process services remain realm-local.
